Subject: Onsite health & incident runbook for Acme Exec Workshop

Team —

Acme's exec workshop is next week (Dec 23–24) at their Palo Alto HQ. Before we lock travel guidance and distributes attendee instructions, I want a short, practical runbook covering:

- Immediate actions for medical incidents (on-site first aid, when to call 911 vs private med services)
- Chain of escalation (who we notify internally and at Acme)
- Evacuation / shelter-in-place triggers (fire, chemical, civil disruption)
- Local emergency contacts and transport options (ambulance, nearby hospitals)
- Communication templates for families/stakeholders and press (if applicable)

Can you draft a 1–2 page runbook and a one‑page wallet card (digital PDF stub) that we can attach to attendee emails? Attachments should be lightweight — we'll keep a master Google Doc for edits.

Deliverable: first draft by EOD Friday (Dec 19). I'll loop in Maya Health Security for local medical vendor details once we have a draft.

Thanks,

Sean
Sean Gallagher

Sean —

Attached is a first draft runbook and a one‑page "what to do" card for attendees. I kept the language direct and action-oriented. Highlights:

- 3-step immediate response for medical events (assess-call-contain), with short checklist for non-medical staff
- Clear notification tree (internal CS lead -> onsite sales lead -> legal -> exec sponsor)
- Local hospital + urgent care addresses + ETA estimate from Acme office by car
- A section on travel advisories (airport disruptions) and a recommended fallback hotel near a major hospital

Please review and let me know edits. I left placeholders for the local med vendor and ambulance contact — will fill after Maya replies.

- Add step for verifying attendee medication/allergies during check‑in for any high‑risk sessions

Local contacts:
- Palo Alto Ambulance (911 primary; non-emergency line: +1-650-555-2333)
- Stanford Hospital ED: +1-650-723-5111 (address: 450 Broadway St)
- Maya on-call medic (Samir Patel) +1-650-555-9001

We will also provide a small first‑aid kit and an on‑site medic for the two workshop days. I'll email a short medical incident report template and a copy of our liability certificate for Acme.
